summary: Found one concrete recovery defect in final batch review repair handling. No source files were changed.
checks: Read-only review of `git diff HEAD^ HEAD` and the relevant owner workflow modules; no tests run.

findings.title: Final review repair changes are not re-reviewed
findings.evidence: When the combined review reports blocking findings, this branch runs the fixer and loops back to review. If the fixer returns `complete: true` with no `clarify` outcome but leaves `blocking` findings, lines 153–156 do not pause or reject that result. The loop can then accept a later successful review and mark the batch ready, even though the final fixer report itself still records blocking findings. This can occur when the fixer cannot resolve all combined-review blockers but reports a complete attempt; the batch becomes eligible for commit association and fixed-in replies despite that unresolved verification result.
